rationale: Charlie's conviction that AI is expanding who can build software aligns directly with Symphony Creative Studio's mission to democratize video ad creation through generative AI tooling. While Charlie focuses on mobile app development infrastructure (Expo, React Native) and Symphony operates in the generative video and adtech space, both are building platforms that lower the barrier to entry for creators and builders—Charlie through developer tools and Symphony through AI-powered creative automation.
intro_message: Charlie Cheever, meet Symphony Creative Studio — you're both building infrastructure to expand who can ship software, just in different mediums (mobile apps vs. AI-generated video content).
